scope: Claude Code 2.1.283 installed on this Windows machine (native installer). Hook stdin schema, hook-visible turn identity, host-written session state and adjacent channels were inspected read-only. No hook configuration, ~/.claude settings, plugin, broker, store, host adapter or product code was changed; nothing was installed or downloaded.

releaseIdentity.versionStoreFileSha256: NOT_RUN: the hash command was denied by the Claude Code auto-mode permission classifier and was not retried by another route
releaseIdentity.officialReleaseDigestComparison: NOT_RUN: fetching the release manifest or binary would be a download, which this task forbids
releaseIdentity.sourceAvailability: Claude Code is distributed as a compiled single executable with an embedded minified JavaScript bundle; no public source tree was available to pin. The inspected 'source' is the bundle text inside the version-store file, located by byte offset.
releaseIdentity.binding: Version-to-bundle correspondence is limited to: the launcher reports 2.1.283, the launcher and versions/2.1.283 have the same byte size, and the bundle offsets below were read from versions/2.1.283. Byte identity of the two files and correspondence with an official release digest were not established.
releaseIdentity.runningSessionVersion: The host-written session registry records inspected (~/.claude/sessions/10852.json and this writer's own 13484.json) report version 2.1.283. These are unauthenticated same-user files and are version context only.

sourceLocations.finding: Embedded hook-input schema: session_id, transcript_path, cwd, prompt_id (optional; described as a UUID correlating a user prompt with subsequent events until the next prompt, absent until the first user input of the process lifetime, joinable to OpenTelemetry prompt.id), permission_mode, agent_id (subagent only), and further optional fields.

Base hook-input builder returns {session_id, transcript_path, cwd, scratchpad_dir, prompt_id, permission_mode, agent_id, agent_type, effort}. An alternative branch returns session_id as `served:<origin.callerSessionId or unknown>` with an empty transcript_path, so the session_id value can be derived from a caller-supplied origin field rather than a host-minted session.

SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and Stop/SubagentStop inputs spread the base fields and add event fields (source/model/agent_type/session_title; prompt/session_title; stop_hook_active/last_assistant_message/background_tasks/session_crons, plus agent_id/agent_transcript_path for SubagentStop). None of these constructions adds turn_id, a signature, a nonce, or a host process identity.
Only the MessageDisplay hook input carries turn_id (with message_id, index, final, delta); the embedded schema at offset 202420546 describes it as 'UUID of the current turn'.
A separate turn_id reader accepts a string turn_id from an inbound object only for relayed human messages (ccrTurnId). This is an input-validation path, not an attestation delivered to hooks.

channels.description: JSON written by the host to a command hook child's stdin
channels.providedVersusAuthenticated: Provides session_id, prompt_id, transcript_path, cwd, permission_mode, effort, agent ids and event fields. No field or construction binds these values to the host executable, a process instance, or a turn in a way a separately invoked verifier could check; any same-user process can start the same hook command with identical-looking JSON.
channels.falsifier: A 2.1.283 bundle location or reproducible installed-release observation that delivers a host-signed or otherwise verifiable process-and-turn claim to the hook child would overturn this. Field presence, a matching PID or a claude.exe process name would not.

channels.description: Environment variables set for hook commands
channels.providedVersusAuthenticated: No documented variable is described as an origin credential. Enumerating undocumented variables from the installed bundle was denied by the auto-mode permission classifier (credential exploration) and was not pursued by any other route.
channels.falsifier: An approved inspection showing a per-hook host-issued secret with a verifier contract would move this to PRESENT; showing none would move it to ABSENT.

channels.description: turn_id availability for UserPromptSubmit, Stop and other hook events
channels.channelExists: ABSENT for UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SubagentStop and SessionStart; PRESENT only for MessageDisplay
channels.providedVersusAuthenticated: MessageDisplay turn_id and the prompt_id correlation UUID are plain fields. prompt_id is absent until the first user input and is a correlation key, not an exclusivity or authority token.
channels.falsifier: A bundle path adding turn_id or a verifiable turn claim to UserPromptSubmit/Stop inputs.

channels.description: Whether hook-visible data can prove exactly one active turn when turn_id is absent
counterEvidence: Stop input carries background_tasks and session_crons, so work can continue in a session outside the foreground prompt.
Subagent hook inputs carry agent_id/agent_type, so several agents can fire hooks under one session_id.
The session registry has kind values including 'bg' and status busy/idle; session state alone does not serialize turns.
prompt_id changes per user prompt but no field states that no other prompt or agent is concurrently active.
channels.falsifier: A documented or bundle-level guarantee, delivered with the hook input, that a session admits one active turn and identifies it verifiably.

channels.channelExists: PRESENT (32 files observed, JSON records and .key files together; JSON fields pid, sessionId, cwd, startedAt, procStart, version, peerProtocol, peerFeatures, kind, entrypoint, pidDomain, messagingSocketPath, name, nameSource, nameSince, jobId, status, statusUpdatedAt, updatedAt, bridgeSessionId)
channels.providedVersusAuthenticated: These are same-user files keyed by PID and process start time. Same-user readability and writability cannot establish a separate principal, and PID/procStart are excluded as authority. The .key files were listed by name and size only; their contents were not read and their purpose is UNKNOWN.
channels.falsifier: Evidence that the registry or key material is protected from other same-user processes and paired with a verifier bound to the host executable and turn.

channels.providedVersusAuthenticated: The bundle has a branch that forms session_id from a caller-supplied origin.callerSessionId (`served:` prefix). session_id is therefore an identifier, not proof of which host or process produced the event.
channels.falsifier: Not applicable; an identifier cannot become an attestation by itself.

channels.description: Host-to-MCP-server requests and transcript JSONL files
channels.providedVersusAuthenticated: Not inspected. Transcripts are same-user files and could not establish a separate principal even if they carried turn data.
channels.falsifier: A later scoped inspection of MCP request metadata or transcript records.
